skills.name: inspect_screen
skills.description: Inspect the screen or active window with a single visual frame and locally extracted OCR text. The result says whether the visual frame was submitted; if visual_input is ocr_only, rely only on OCR and window metadata.

region.description: Region to inspect: full screen or focused active window.

extract_text.description: Whether to extract visible on-screen text using OCR.

skills.name: list_windows
skills.description: List all currently open application windows across all workspaces, including application name, window title, workspace ID, and focus state.

workspace.description: Optional workspace number to filter windows by.

skills.name: focus_window
skills.description: Bring an open application window to the foreground and focus it by application class, title substring, or window address.

query.description: Application name (e.g. 'foot', 'firefox'), title keyword, or window address.

skills.name: list_workspaces
skills.description: List all active desktop workspaces, their window counts, and which workspace is currently active.

skills.name: get_system_resources
skills.description: Check real-time hardware health and system performance: CPU load percentage, RAM usage, disk storage, and top resource-consuming processes.
